The maths behind the comparison.

We estimate a fixed-rate loan with equal monthly payments on a reducing balance. Payments start one month after disbursal.

EMI = P × r ÷ [1 − (1 + r)−n]
P
Loan principal in rupees
r
Annual interest rate ÷ 12 ÷ 100
n
Number of monthly payments

At 0% interest, EMI is simply principal ÷ months.

  • Total interest: EMI × months − principal.
  • Upfront fees: processing fee + other charges you enter.
  • Total repayment: all monthly payments + upfront fees.
  • Cost of borrowing: total interest + upfront fees.

Fees are paid separately upfront and aren’t added to the financed amount. Include applicable taxes and required charges in “Other charges”.

This model excludes changing rates, daily interest, prepayments, late fees, moratoriums and insurance unless entered as an upfront charge. Figures use full precision internally and are displayed rounded. Your lender’s repayment schedule may differ.
